comment: The pulse roster (D139, five at D203): a short question answered once per scheduled day and drawn as a line. Exactly five ordered options each — the trends chart's y-axis is the 1..5 step scale, and the card renders five growing dots. `pace` shipped first and deliberately neutral, because a wellbeing question moves the App Store's Health row; D166 §3 weighed that and approved the full roster, so `sleep` and `energy` are here and docs/STORE-FORMS.md answers Health YES accordingly. CADENCE IS NOT IN THIS FILE and must not be: it is per-person device state (`insight.pulseCadence.v1`), so the bank says what may be asked and the phone says how often. Ids stay underscore-free — `_` is the day separator the rules parse the answer id on. `pace` keeps its option set forever (D52 freezes a shipped one); a reworded pulse is a new id, never an edit here. No provenance rows: the pulse bank is editorial-only and outside the farm's lanes.

questions.prompt: How clear was your head today?
How connected did you feel today?
